'''Roos Londabir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Londabir offered to help [[Dersa Welles]], the leader of a criminal organization known as the [[Intarsa League]], to established a shell company. Welles acceppted his offer and Londabir agreed to meet with Welles and the League on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], to complete some paperwork in relation to the company. However, during his meeting with Welles, the Intarsa League were attacked by a rival criminal faction and Londabir was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a round of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.
